quote.text: Do not act as if you were going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over you. While you live, while it is in your power, be good.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that each moment with your children is finite; invest in their character and growth today rather than postponing wisdom for an indefinite future.
    • By modeling goodness and conscious presence, you impart lasting virtues—teaching your children that acting rightly matters more than merely counting the years.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, understand that the time to enact ethical decisions is now; delaying meaningful action risks the loss of both purpose and morale.
    • Embrace the transient nature of life as a call to lead with integrity and urgency, inspiring others to commit to quality and moral guidance in every circumstance.
  • Product Management
    • In a fast-paced environment, remember that opportunity is limited; focus on delivering real value with each iteration rather than waiting for a perfect moment.
    • Prioritize ethical and purposeful decision-making in product strategy, ensuring that every step taken today embodies the goodness you wish to see, rather than assuming endless time for improvement.
